coordinates.sourceLongitude: east-positive 0..360 centered at 180 degrees; output columns half-raster shifted to -180..180

heightPolicy: Measured Schenk 2024 DEM elevations relative to the Thomas et al. 2016 triaxial ellipsoid, converted to physical radial height as ellipsoidRadius(direction) + DEM elevation - runtime canonical radius. Source NoData is explicitly filled and labeled; no color or brightness inference.

provenance.processing: Validated GeoTIFF tags/georeferencing; converted source km to metres; computed triaxial radial surface radius by pixel direction; shifted source 0..360 seam by half raster; encoded radial heights as uint16 little-endian at 0.5 m steps; filled NoData with reference triaxial ellipsoid (zero relief) and labeled it.
provenance.attribution: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA Cassini / Lunar and Planetary Institute; Schenk and McKinnon (2024); Thomas et al. (2016)

preview.colorKind: constant soft-ice fallback; no mapped color source was downloaded

medium.colorKind: constant soft-ice fallback; no mapped color source was downloaded
medium.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; radial height = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters
medium.noDataPolicy: Source NoData is filled with the reference triaxial ellipsoid (zero relief); filled samples are not measured terrain.

near.colorKind: constant soft-ice fallback; no mapped color source was downloaded
near.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; radial height = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters
near.noDataPolicy: Source NoData is filled with the reference triaxial ellipsoid (zero relief); filled samples are not measured terrain.
